routes.name: Nairobi to Naivasha, old road
routes.note: The descent carries almost all of the risk. Avoid in the first twenty minutes of rain.

routes.name: Nanyuki to Archers Post
routes.note: Last certain fuel is well before the northern stretch. Heat is the limiting factor after ten in the morning.

routes.name: Kampala to Jinja
routes.note: Traffic density rather than surface is the difficulty. Leaving before six changes the ride completely.

routes.name: Arusha to Moshi
routes.note: Crosswind on the open sections is stronger than the terrain suggests, particularly with luggage.

routes.name: Kigali to Musanze
routes.note: Sustained climbing and frequent low cloud. Dress for a temperature drop you will not feel until you are in it.

routes.name: Nakuru to Kericho
routes.note: Afternoon rain is close to routine in season. Plan the ride around the window, not through it.
